name: Pop
description: Melody-led popular music built around catchy songs, hooks and contemporary production.

name: Rock
description: Guitar, bass and drum based music rooted in rock and roll, from classic to modern styles.

name: Hard rock
description: Loud, riff-driven rock with distorted guitars and powerful vocals.

name: Metal
description: Heavy, high-intensity music with distorted guitars and forceful drums, covering styles from heavy metal to metalcore.

name: Alternative
description: Independent-minded rock and pop outside the mainstream, including indie rock and indie pop.

name: Punk
description: Fast, raw and direct rock music with short songs and a do-it-yourself attitude.

name: Hip hop
description: Rhythm-driven music centred on rapping over beats, samples and programmed drums.

name: R&B
description: Contemporary rhythm and blues with smooth vocals, groove-based rhythms and modern production.

name: Soul and funk
description: Groove-heavy music driven by expressive vocals, bass lines and horn or rhythm sections.

name: Electronic
description: Music made mainly with synthesisers, drum machines and computers, from electronica to ambient textures.

name: Dance
description: Club-oriented music made for dancing, such as house, EDM, trance and dance pop.

name: Afrobeats
description: Contemporary West African popular music built on syncopated rhythms, blending highlife, dancehall, hip hop and R&B.

name: Gospel
description: Vocal-led music with roots in African American church traditions, often featuring choirs and call and response.

name: Worship
description: Songs written for congregational singing, typically with band arrangements and singable melodies.

name: Choral
description: Music written for and performed by choirs or vocal ensembles.

name: A cappella
description: Vocal music performed without instrumental accompaniment, from small vocal groups to larger ensembles.

name: Singer-songwriter
description: Song-focused music performed by the writer, usually with acoustic guitar or piano.

name: Easy listening
description: Gentle, melodic music with an emphasis on vocals and smooth arrangements, including vocal standards.

name: Folk
description: Acoustic and traditional music drawing on regional folk songs, instruments and storytelling.

name: Country
description: Song-driven music from the American country tradition, including Americana and bluegrass.

name: Blues
description: Music built on blues scales, chord progressions and expressive vocal and guitar playing.

name: Celtic
description: Music rooted in the traditions of Ireland, Scotland, Brittany and other Celtic regions, often featuring fiddle, pipes and whistle.

name: Jazz
description: Improvisation-based music with swing, rich harmony and instrumental solos.

name: Classical
description: Composed art music for orchestra, ensembles or soloists, from early music to contemporary works.

name: Reggae
description: Jamaican-rooted music with offbeat rhythms, heavy bass lines and relaxed grooves.

name: Instrumental
description: Music without vocals, where melody is carried by instruments.

name: Ambient
description: Atmospheric, slow-moving music focused on texture and mood rather than rhythm.

name: Soundtrack
description: Music written for film, television, games or stage productions.
